issues.description: The template Lecture.java declares some attributes as public (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents) while the problem UML lists these attributes as private and the provided solution implements all attributes as private. This inconsistency may confuse students about the intended visibility and whether they should modify or reuse the existing public fields.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the UML and solution by removing the pre-declared public fields or changing them to private. Leave a clear TODO asking students to add the five private attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) so they implement visibility according to the specification.
